blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Mamamayang Liberal party-list Rep. Leila de Lima on Monday said the Liberal Party (LP) sis till hoping thaf Naga City Mayor Leni Robredo will reconsider her decision to no longer pursue national office in the 2028 elections. De Lima praised Robredo’s commitment to leading the city that her late husband had led for almost 20 years, saying that her dedication is precisely what drives calls for her to re-enter national politics. “I maintain that she’s the best hope of our country,” de Lima, who also chairs LP which Robredo is a member, said in a statement.
